description: This file defines a WearableActivity that handles permission requests for reading the calendar. It presents a UI for users to grant permission and handles the result of that request.

classes.name: CalendarWatchFacePermissionActivity
classes.description: An activity that manages permissions for reading the calendar on a wearable device, prompting the user and handling their response.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and enables ambient mode.

methods.name: onClickEnablePermission
methods.description: Triggered when the user clicks a button to request calendar permission.

methods.name: onRequestPermissionsResult
methods.description: Handles the result of the permission request, finishing the activity if permission is granted.
